model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot is titled "Massive Activation of baseline" and it illustrates the maximum activation values of different outputs and residuals across various layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick labels at intervals of 200. There are four lines in the plot, each representing a different output or residual. The "attn_output" is represented by a blue dashed line, the "attn_residual" by an orange dotted line, the "ffn_output" by a green dash-dot line, and the "ffn_residual" by a red solid line. The "attn_output" line starts at a value of 0, sharply increases to a peak of around 1600 at layer 5, and then gradually decreases to 0 by layer 22. The "attn_residual" line follows a similar pattern but with a lower peak, reaching a maximum value of around 1400 at layer 5. The "ffn_output" line starts at 0, increases to a peak of around 800 at layer 5, and then decreases to 0 by layer 22. The "ffn_residual" line has a similar pattern to the "ffn_output" but with a lower peak, reaching a maximum value of around 600 at layer 5. The plot does not provide any additional context or data points beyond the values at the start and end of the x-axis.
